audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer rates this HARD 8/10 with Pantheon winning every row of the level chart, while the content layer, packet.levelChart and a 54.13% win rate over 1040 games all say Akshan.
audit.why: A 54.13% win rate is not a hard lane. Akshan's Q reaches 850 against Comet Spear's 575, and Shield Vault is his only way in.
audit.corrected: Even-to-favoured lane: you win it at range, and you lose it the moment Shield Vault connects.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and whys[5] sit on the wrong stages, and 'Grand Skyfall' is not one of his abilities.
audit.why: Row 4 is Level 6 — Grand Starfall, a 180/165/150-second global that buys map pressure rather than duel power. Row 5 is First item.
audit.corrected: Level 6 = a 180-second Grand Starfall for roams; First item = swing-autos shred, but only from an angle Aegis Assault is not facing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault's directional block is never stated in the interaction fields, Shield Vault's auto-attack reset is missing, and Heroic Swing is described as a dash.
audit.why: Aegis Assault (E, 22/21/20/19/18s) makes Pantheon invulnerable to damage from the FRONT only — every one of Akshan's damage sources is a frontal projectile, so a straight-on string does nothing while a flank string does full damage. Shield Vault (W, 13/12/11/10/9s) carries an auto-attack reset, so the attack wind-up, not the cast, is the cue to step back. Aegis Assault is a channel and any crowd control cancels it, which is your jungler's job, not yours.
audit.corrected: Do not shoot into a raised Aegis Assault — swing around it with Heroic Swing and the same string lands in full. Treat his auto wind-up as the Shield Vault tell and step out before the dash, not after the stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers behind 'commit on its cooldown'.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 13s at rank 1 and Aegis Assault 22s — those two gaps are the whole lane.
audit.corrected: String him in the 13 seconds after Shield Vault and the 22 after Aegis Assault.
